Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class TrainingDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<Training,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.TrainingDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<Training,Long>, TrainingDAO
public class TrainingDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<Training,Long> implements TrainingDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the TrainingDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing training programs within the application. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specific business logic for training catalog management, availability tracking, and advanced filtering capabilities.

Key implementation features:

  • Complex JPQL subqueries for participation-based filtering
  • Criteria API implementation for dynamic filtering
  • Training availability detection for user recommendations
  • Multi-field search capabilities across training properties
  • Enum handling for language and status filtering
  • Dynamic sorting with configurable field and direction

  • Method Details

    • findTrainingsNotParticipatedByUser

      public List<Training> findTrainingsNotParticipatedByUser(Long userId)
      Finds trainings that a specific user has not yet participated in.

      This method returns available training opportunities for a user by excluding trainings they have already completed or are currently enrolled in. Useful for recommending new training programs and displaying available learning opportunities.

      Implementation notes: Utilizes a JPQL subquery to identify trainings where the specified user is not already registered as a participant. This prevents duplicate registrations and ensures clean training catalog filtering for user recommendations. Only active trainings are returned to maintain data integrity.

      Query structure: 

       SELECT t FROM Training t 
 WHERE t.isActive = true AND t.id NOT IN (
   SELECT tp.training.id FROM TrainingParticipation tp 
   WHERE tp.participant.id = :userId
 )
      Specified by:
      findTrainingsNotParticipatedByUser in interface TrainingDAO
      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of trainings not participated by the user, or an empty list if no available trainings exist

    • getTrainingsByFilters

      public List<Training> getTrainingsByFilters(TrainingFilter filters)
      Retrieves trainings based on complex filtering criteria.

      This method provides advanced querying capabilities using a filter object that can specify multiple criteria such as training area, date ranges, status, location, and other training properties. Essential for implementing search and filtering functionality in training catalogs.

      Implementation notes: Implements sophisticated multi-criteria filtering using JPA Criteria API for dynamic query construction. This method provides extensive filtering capabilities including:

      • Entity filtering: By ID and training area relationships
      • Enum handling: Language filtering with case-insensitive matching
      • Date filtering: Start date comparison using Instant parsing
      • Status filtering: Active-only training visibility control
      • Text search: Multi-field text matching across title and description
      • Dynamic sorting: Configurable field and direction-based ordering

      The method constructs predicates dynamically based on non-null filter values, ensuring optimal query performance by only including necessary conditions. Text search utilizes SQL LIKE operations with wildcard matching for flexible discovery capabilities.

      Performance considerations:

      • Predicate lists are pre-allocated for efficient memory usage
      • Enum comparisons use string conversion for database compatibility
      • Conditional query building reduces unnecessary database load
      Specified by:
      getTrainingsByFilters in interface TrainingDAO
      Parameters:
      filters - The filter criteria to apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of trainings matching the filter criteria, or an empty list if no matches are found
